patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — IPRoyal and Zyte share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — IPRoyal and Zyte share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose IPRoyal only if your buying job matches “Residential proxies from $1.75/GB — ISP/datacenter/mobile lines; traffic that never expire” rather than Zyte's shape. Choose Zyte only if your buying job matches “Zyte API web-data collection (formerly Scrapinghub) — PAYG; monthly commitments from $100;” rather than IPRoyal's shape. Workflow advantage differs because IPRoyal is shaped for Residential proxies from $1.75/GB — ISP/datacenter/mobile lines; traff whereas Zyte is shaped for Zyte API web-data collection (formerly Scrapinghub) — PAYG; monthly co. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — IPRoyal and Zyte share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: IPRoyal is Residential proxies from $1.75/GB — ISP/datacenter/mobile lines; traffic that never expires framing. Does not outrank Bright Data 7.7.; Zyte is Zyte API web-data collection (formerly Scrapinghub) — PAYG; monthly commitments from $100; $5 free trial credit. Does not outrank Bright Dat.
- Company-size focus: IPRoyal (solo, micro, small-business) vs Zyte (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: IPRoyal — Does not outrank Bright Data (7.7); Zyte — Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products.

Limitations — IPRoyal: Does not outrank Bright Data (7.7); Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs; Zyte: Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products; Does not outrank Bright Data (7.7).

Poor-fit cases: IPRoyal is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Bright Data (7.7) · Zyte is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products · Avoid IPRoyal if you actually need Zyte's motion (Zyte API web-data collection (formerly Scrapinghub) — PAYG; monthly commitments )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
